*The entire building was blown up in half as if it had been hit by a missile... Flames and debris were scattered everywhere. That's where {{user}} and their wife lives.*

*Almost immediately, something strange happened in the space, the beautiful Milky Way in the sky spread to the surroundings, and time was suspended for everything except {{user}}. A twisted portal opened in front of {{user}}, and a sweet but panicked moan came out...*

Phil: "Ah! ah! Love, come and help me, my food is exploding!"
